description: Anime-style character visual upgrade in stickman-renderer.js. Adds tapered limbs, body silhouette, larger detailed heads with hair shapes, nose/mouth, hands/feet, and per-character unique details (Bitos scarf, Laziness aura, Gadget visor, etc.). Backward-compatible: charId is optional in options, silhouette mode bypasses all detail layers. Must be done before FEAT-003 (menu) and FEAT-005 (cinematic) so those scenes benefit from upgraded characters.
steps: 1. Edit public/src/animation/stickman-renderer.js drawStickman() signature — add 'charId = null' to the destructured options parameter. This is the only API change.

2. In drawStickman(), after the existing flash pass and before ctx.restore(), add a call: if (!silhouette && charId !== null) { drawAnimeUpgrade(ctx, solved, { x, y, facing, height, color, accent, lineWidth, glow, charId }, lw); }

3. Create private function drawAnimeUpgrade(ctx, solved, opts, lw) in stickman-renderer.js. This function does: (a) ctx.save() at start, ctx.restore() at end. (b) Tapered limb fills: for each limb pair (shoulderF→elbowF, elbowF→handF, hipF→kneeF, kneeF→footF, shoulderB→elbowB, elbowB→handB, hipB→kneeB, kneeB→footB) draw a filled trapezoid path. Width at proximal joint = lw*1.4, at distal joint = lw*0.7. Use ctx.fillStyle = rgba(opts.color, 0.55). (c) Body silhouette: draw filled quadrilateral from shoulderF to shoulderB to hipB to hipF using rgba(opts.color, 0.45). (d) Hand circles: ctx.beginPath(), ctx.arc(px(handF), py(handF), lw*0.85, 0, TAU), fill with rgba(opts.color, 0.9). Same for handB at 0.6 alpha. (e) Foot ovals: ctx.save(), ctx.translate(px(footF), py(footF)), ctx.scale(1, 0.45), ctx.arc(0, 0, lw*1.1, 0, TAU), ctx.restore(), fill rgba(opts.color, 0.7). Same for footB. (f) Larger head overlay: ctx.beginPath(), ctx.arc(px(head), py(head), headRadius*0.35 + lw*0.3, 0, TAU), fill rgba(opts.color, 0.25). (g) Default hair shape: filled bezier arc above head in mixHex(opts.color, '#2a1a0a', 0.6). (h) Nose dot: small circle at (px(head)+headRadius*0.18, py(head)+headRadius*0.12), radius lw*0.22, fill rgba(opts.accent, 0.6). (i) Mouth curve: ctx.beginPath(), ctx.arc from left to right at bottom of head with small radius, stroke rgba(opts.accent, 0.4). All coordinates use px()/py() transform helper inherited from scope.

4. Add per-charId switch block inside drawAnimeUpgrade after the generic layers: switch(opts.charId) { case 'creator-bitos': draw dark-brown (#3d2106) hair blob (filled bezier, swept right, starts at top of head, extends 1.2*headRadius above and 0.6 to the right); draw scarf rectangle (red-black #8b0000 fillRect at neck position, width headRadius*1.8, height headRadius*0.4); two red accent diagonal stripes on torso (stroke #ff2b3c from chest to hip, thin, low alpha 0.4). break; case 'laziness': droopy hair (dark purple #4a2b6b bezier paths hanging down to shoulder level, two thick strands); purple radial aura behind character (globalCompositeOperation='lighter', radial gradient from rgba(#7b4bd6, 0.22) to transparent, radius=height*0.55). break; case 'gadget': visor bar (ctx.fillRect across eye region, cyan #22d3ee, height headRadius*0.28, alpha 0.85); two antenna bumps (small rectangles atop head); 3 cyan circuit lines on front arm (thin bezier paths, stroke #22d3ee, alpha 0.5). break; case 'addiction': hollow eye sockets (draw two rings with ctx.strokeStyle='#0a0a1a', lineWidth=lw*0.18, no fill, over the face area); cracked vein lines on front forearm (3 branching thin strokes from elbow toward hand, dark blue #0a1a3d, alpha 0.7). break; case 'society': grey suit collar lines (two diagonal strokes from neck outward to shoulders, grey #9aa0a6, lineWidth=lw*0.6); crowd echo silhouettes: draw 3 copies of body silhouette and torso at offsets (+50,+10), (+100,+20), (-60,+5) with alpha 0.06, color '#9aa0a6'. break; case 'seizure': draw all limbs again at (+8, 0) offset with rgba(#22d3ee, 0.14) and at (-6, 0) with rgba(#ff3dbe, 0.12), globalCompositeOperation='lighter'. break; case 'wrath': spiky hair: 6 filled triangle spikes radiating from head top in a fan, color #ff7a18; flame circles at handF and handB: radial gradient from rgba(#ff7a18,0.7) to transparent, radius lw*2.2, globalCompositeOperation='lighter'. break; case 'school': V-collar lines (two strokes from neck point outward and down to chest level, white #fff3bd, alpha 0.7); small rectangle badge on chest (fillRect, yellow #f5c518, width lw*1.4, height lw*1.0). break; case 'suffering': heavy dark aura (radial gradient from rgba(0,0,0,0.45) to transparent behind character, radius height*0.65, globalCompositeOperation='multiply'); draw torso and back limbs again with rgba(#4a0a0a, 0.35) extra thick (lineWidth lw*1.5). break; case 'lust': flowing hair (pink #ff3dbe, wavy bezier path starting at head top, flowing 1.5*headRadius behind, 3 control points with sin-based Y offsets using a fixed phase from charId); 3 pink ghost silhouettes offset behind (drawStickman called recursively with silhouette=true, silhouetteColor='#ff3dbe', alpha=0.08, x offset -18,-36,-54 in facing direction). break; }

5. Edit public/src/scenes/boot.js drawStickman calls for Bitos — add charId: 'creator-bitos'. Add charId: 'society' for the Society character draw. Add charId: 'seizure' for the Seizure character draw. Note: silhouette draws (for the existing enemy row) keep charId omitted or null.
6. Edit public/src/scenes/menu.js #drawBitos() — add charId: 'creator-bitos' to the main drawStickman call. Also add charId: 'creator-bitos' to the logout confirm panel's drawStickman call.

7. Edit public/src/scenes/intro.js #drawBitos() — add charId: 'creator-bitos' to both drawStickman calls for Bitos. In the enemy loop, add charId: e.id to the colored (non-silhouette) drawStickman call. Keep the rim-light silhouette call without charId.
8. Edit public/src/combat/fighter.js renderState() method — add 'id: this.def.id' to the returned state object so battle.js can pass charId to drawStickman.
9. Edit public/src/scenes/battle.js #drawWorld() — in the drawStickman call for fighters, add charId: state.id.
10. Edit public/src/scenes/campaign.js #drawCard() and #drawConfirm() — add charId: def.id to all colored drawStickman calls (portrait and confirm VS layout). Keep silhouette calls without charId.
acceptance_criteria: Creator Bitos in any scene shows dark-brown hair, red-black scarf at neck, and red accent stripes on torso
Silhouette mode (locked campaign cards, intro rim-lights) renders as solid colored shape with no detail layers visible
All existing callers that do NOT pass charId still work identically (charId defaults to null, upgrade skipped)
Wrath shows spiky orange hair and flame effects at fists
Seizure shows glitch offset copies in cyan and magenta
Laziness shows droopy purple hair and aura
Gadget shows cyan visor bar across eyes
Society shows crowd echo silhouettes behind it
All characters have hands (small circles) and feet (small ovals) visible
verification: npx serve public — navigate to Campaign, open a round confirm panel — both characters should show upgraded visuals
Verify silhouette mode: locked rounds in campaign should still show solid black shapes
node tools/scene-smoke.js — all scene tests pass
node tools/flash-test.js — Seizure glitch effect must not cause flash violations (it uses alpha 0.12-0.14, well below threshold)
findings: All 10 charId cases implemented. Tapered limbs, hands, feet, hair, nose, mouth added as generic layers. Per-character: creator-bitos gets dark-brown swept hair + red-black scarf + torso stripes; laziness gets droopy purple hair + radial aura; gadget gets cyan visor + antennas + circuit lines; addiction gets hollow eye rings + cracked veins; society gets collar lines + crowd echo silhouettes; seizure gets cyan/magenta glitch offset limbs (alpha 0.14/0.12, no strobe); wrath gets spiky orange hair + flame fist glows; school gets V-collar + yellow badge; suffering gets dark multiply aura + thick back limbs; lust gets wavy pink hair + ghost torso offsets. Silhouette mode bypasses all upgrade layers. Backward-compatible (charId defaults to null). smoke-test 42/42, flash-test 12/12.
